# 1 Enoch Chapter 97 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch — Woe Oracles

---

**97:1** Know-ye-that-the-sons-of-men-will-be-made-to-swear-by-the-great-oath in-the-midst-of-the-holy, and-they-will-give-the-holy-ones-to-eat, and-the-sons-of-heaven-will-be-their-judges-in-those-days, and-they-will-swear-before-them.

**97:2** And-in-those-days-none-shall-be-saved-either-by-gold-or-by-silver, and-none-shall-be-able-to-escape.

**97:3** And-there-shall-be-no-iron-for-war, nor-shall-ye-put-on-a-breastplate: bronze-shall-be-of-no-service, and-tin shall-be-of-no-service-and-shall-not-be-esteemed, and-lead-shall-not-be-desired.

**97:4** All-these-things-shall-be-refused-and-destroyed-from-the-surface-of-the-earth, when-the-Elect-One-shall-appear before-the-face-of-the-Lord-of-Spirits.

**97:5** Woe to-you-who-work-godlessness and-boast-of-your-own-glory; ye-who-devour-your-own-soul, who-eat-the-best-fruit-of-the-earth and-consider-it-as-righteous.

**97:6** Know-ye-therefore that-ye-shall-be-delivered-into-the-hands-of-the-righteous, and-they-will-cut-off-your-necks-and-slay-you, and-have-no-mercy-upon-you.

**97:7** Woe to-you-who-rejoice-in-the-tribulation-of-the-righteous; for-no-grave-shall-be-dug-for-you.

**97:8** Woe to-those-who-set-at-naught-the-words-of-the-righteous; for-ye-shall-have-no-hope-of-life.

**97:9** Woe to-those-who-write-down-lying-and-godless-words; for-they-write-down-their-lies-that-men-may-hear-them-and-act-godlessly-towards-their-neighbour.

**97:10** Therefore-they-shall-have-no-peace-but-shall-die-a-swift-death.

---

*EMET notes: V. 1 appears to describe a heavenly court scene where the holy ones swear and give testimony. Vv. 3–4 describe the abolition of all instruments of war at the coming of the Elect One — a disarmament eschatology. V. 9 targets those who write down lies and false teaching — an unusual oracle against literary deception that may reflect scribal polemics within the Enochic community.*
